title: NodeVault legacy ToolSpec raw_spec (v0 compatibility)
description: Machine-checkable governance artifact for the historical first-image ToolSpec raw_spec shape produced by NodeKit's raw_spec generator (docs/TOOL_CONTRACT_V0_2.md). It is a COMPATIBILITY schema: it documents the fields NodeVault derives identity from and does NOT tighten historical acceptance. Runtime resolution preserves legacy-v0 digests byte-for-byte; this schema must never be used to re-derive or reject an already-resolved legacy record.

image_uri.description: Base image reference; a pinned @sha256:<64hex> suffix is extracted as the base image digest. Unpinned refs yield an empty digest under legacy rules.
